clips.end_words: This is how you get lucky
clips.caption:
Researchers ran a random number generator a billion times. Right around half the time it landed on one number, half on the other, like flipping a fair coin.

Then they sat someone down in front of the same machine and had them simply want more ones than zeros, over and over.

The number one started coming up more. Not 50/50 anymore. 51, even 52 percent.

They repeated it again and again. Every time, the person's desire bent the outcome.

Kevin Trudeau calls this empirical evidence that the mind can affect pure chance.

Have you ever wanted something so clearly that it just seemed to show up?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #yourwishisyourcommand #luck #mindset #science

Here's the stranger version of the experiment, according to Kevin Trudeau.

A machine ran a billion random picks between 1 and 0, with nobody watching, and the results were locked in before anyone said a word.

Then they brought in a test subject and asked him to pick a number. He said zero. Now look at the machine, they said. The results are already there. Just want more zeros.

He focused on wanting more zeros. More zeros. More zeros.

They checked the results that had been set before he ever walked in the room. Whatever number he wanted more of, that's what the machine showed.

If the outcome was already fixed, how did his mind still match it?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #yourwishisyourcommand #luck #mindset #science

Kevin Trudeau says the US Army ran this one. DNA was taken from a person and put in a Petri dish in another room.

The person was then shown violent images. Researchers watched the DNA in the body contract. The DNA in the Petri dish, with no physical link to the body, contracted at the same instant.

So they moved the dish further away, then to a lead-lined room on the other side of the planet, where no signal could pass through.

Same result. No delay.

Then they showed the person positive images. The DNA expanded, in the body and across the world, at the same moment.

If your own cells react that fast from that far, what is your mindset actually reaching?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #yourwishisyourcommand #science #energy #mindset
